terms.title: Point Cloud Import
terms.short_def: Technical best practices for Point Cloud Import inside GstarCAD Point Cloud.
terms.definition: Point Cloud Import loads laser scans into the DWG model environment. It handles large point data sets by using local graphics caching.
terms.why_matters: Establishes a reliable spatial reference framework for as-built retrofits and plant remodeling.
common_pitfalls: Importing unregistered point clouds that lack unified coordinate offsets
Setting display density too high causing graphic viewport locks

quiz.question: When working with Point Cloud Import, which of the following represents a common technical pitfall?
options: Importing unregistered point clouds that lack unified coordinate offsets.
Failing to manually re-index the SQL server database.
Over-allocating virtual memory caches in the cloud settings.
Restricting linetype scales strictly to 1:1 paper coordinates.
quiz.explanation: Correct. A common pitfall is 'Importing unregistered point clouds that lack unified coordinate offsets.' As the editorial review notes: 'Establishes a reliable spatial reference framework for as-built retrofits and plant remodeling.'

terms.title: Vector Extraction
terms.short_def: Technical best practices for Vector Extraction inside GstarCAD Point Cloud.
terms.definition: Vector Extraction converts point boundaries into CAD polylines, helping modelers trace scanned geometry.
terms.why_matters: Automates the conversion of physical scan data into lightweight, actionable CAD drawings.
common_pitfalls: Tracing noisy point margins without setting outline filters
Creating over-segmented lines instead of clean, unified polylines

terms.title: Section Clipping
terms.short_def: Technical best practices for Section Clipping inside GstarCAD Point Cloud.
terms.definition: Section Clipping clips point cloud data along reference planes, exposing clean visual slices.
terms.why_matters: Simplifies tracing and reduces visual clutter by hiding extraneous scan points.
common_pitfalls: Clipping too thick of a slice, which retains confusing foreground geometry
Using dynamic coordinate systems that shift clip planes during pan commands

faqs.question: What format of point clouds does GstarCAD Point Cloud support?
faqs.answer: It supports standard formats like LAS, PTS, PTX, and RCP/RCS after conversion. Check the import options for details.

faqs.question: How do I trace outlines on a sliced point cloud?
faqs.answer: Set a section box or clip plane to isolate a slice of data, then use standard object snaps (`OSNAP`) and polyline tools to trace boundaries.

faqs.question: How to optimize viewport navigation for massive point cloud files?
faqs.answer: Reduce the point display density in the properties panel, or turn on hardware acceleration under options to utilize GPU caching.
